title: T430s
description: This is a performance focused modpack made for the Thinkpad T430s with the OS on it being arch linux.
body:
This is a performance focused modpack made for the Thinkpad T430s with the OS on it being arch linux. This whole modpack is generally for lower end devices with my set up being fast graphics and a lot of options turned down or completly off and a the texutere pack (it is a pvp one) zegarn which is already in the modpack i am getting about 100 fps in a bedwars lobby and about 180 fps in the actual bedwars game. Also there is the axolotl client you can activate it by pressing right shift there are some hud mods like keystrokes,fps,cps . And i hope you enjoy this modpack:)
Thanks all the creators of thees mods
